teaser: At the airport gate, you have already worked out which security line moves faster, and you are reading something no one asked about. Life path 7 asks for solitude and an inward search; ENTJ is built for command and forward motion. The crossing here is a mind that wants to run the room and also wants to disappear from it entirely. You lead efficiently, then withdraw to think it through alone, and the people around you learn to notice which version of you showed up that day.
excerpt: When did someone last catch you mid-sentence and ask what you were actually thinking.
